cause_quote: The new loading skeleton used `Array.from({ length: 7 }, ...)` to render seven plain bars regardless of the loaded sidebar’s search field and navigation groups.
user_saw: When Settings opened before the sidebar finished loading, seven plain bars appeared and then shifted into a search field and grouped navigation rows.
summary: The fix builds the loading skeleton from the visible Settings navigation groups and uses the loaded sidebar’s layout for the search field, headings, and rows.
reasoning: The introducing diff replaced a text loading indicator with the seven-bar skeleton. I checked the loaded sidebar in that commit’s parent and confirmed it already rendered a search field and grouped icon-and-label rows, so the skeleton’s layout mismatch shipped with its introduction.
